title: The loop highway
content: One thing that comes up frequently in my dreams is the loop highway that is very steep and near or over a body of water. I frequently have to take the highway to get to snow lake mountain. When you are driving it feels like your “car” is going to fall off just from sheer gravity with its twists and turns. Rarely do I fall off, it just feels like you are going to fall off. The sensation is very uncomfortable like when you are on a rollercoaster, climbing to the top slowly and feeling every second. Eventually you make it past the full vertical that one must traverse. Once you get through that, snow lake mountain town is full of hope. Friendly people there. I never want to leave this place. I get to see people I loved who are gone now. I get to talk to my Grandpa. He likes to fish on the dock by the lake. It is calm and zen. Free of any the white coat observers. Does any of this ring a bell? Thanks for listening.
